end.summary:
Discussed traditional ways of protecting nature.
Identified that roots hold soil and help water enter the ground.
Discussed people’s actions: watering trees, not frightening animals, and protecting trees.
Mentioned Bishnoi people and tree protection.
The “sheep” mix-up was corrected to “trees”; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised how roots help hold soil and how people can protect trees, animals, and water. Asha used examples such as watering trees, not frightening animals, and the Bishnoi community; Dev corrected the sheep/tree mix-up during the lesson. At home, ask Dev to name one traditional community or practice and explain what it protects.
